selection.ownership: Raisely, Melbourne, Australia (founded 2016; LinkedIn headquarters Melbourne VIC 3000). International nonprofit fundraising platform at raisely.com / api.raisely.com; not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Raisely API v3 (https://api.raisely.com/v3, HTTP Bearer API key/JWT, GET /campaigns, /campaigns/{campaign}, /profiles?campaign=, /profiles/{path}, GET /authenticate, 401 unauthorized JSON), developer quickstart, LinkedIn operator identity, changelog public-API spam safeguards on unauthenticated writes (2025-11-05), and dated incident search. No qualifying current unresolved Raisely compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Raisely API v3 uses HTTPS https://api.raisely.com/v3 with Authorization Bearer. Operator is Raisely in Melbourne, Australia. Dated 2026-09-13 incident search found November 2025 unauthenticated-write rate-limit safeguards, not a security compromise.

incidents.finding: Raisely added request limits on unauthenticated public write routes to reduce spam. Authenticated API integrations were unchanged. This is not a data compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck probes GET /campaigns?limit=1 with empty input. The pinned validator uses GET /authenticate, which is not an upstream action ID, so healthcheck maps to list_campaigns.
Native category is payments: Raisely is fundraising. Source Finance is not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.

campaign is required on GET /profiles. Optional private, query (wire name q), limit, and offset use official query names. Rank filters are omitted from this bounded subset.
Path segment is profilePath to preserve origin/main fixtures. Composio RAISELY_GET_PROFILE.path maps to profilePath.
